review.assessment:
The change replaces a backward-iterating accumulator that inadvertently evaluated subtraction right-to-left with a forward pass applying operators strictly left-to-right. This corrects the associativity of additive expressions so chained subtractions now yield standard results like `5` for `"10 - 3 - 2"`. The modification preserves all existing index bounds and precedence assumptions already established by the parser.

Defects: None found. The refactoring directly addresses the stated left-associativity bug without introducing off-by-one errors or altering precedence logic. Host measurements confirm compilation succeeds, structural checks pass, and acceptance tests validate the fix alongside existing coverage.
